list: Official 55-trophy list as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies at all, so the road is long rather than hard. Follow the roadmap in this guide: finish the five story chapters first, then work the 100% Completion checklist, then clean up Strangers & Freaks and the miscellaneous trophies. Nothing on the list needs DLC or multiplayer.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (difficulty, time, 1 playthrough)

steps: Finish the story (5 chapters, ~60-80 hours).
Complete the 100% Completion checklist for A Long Road.
Clean up Strangers & Freaks, collectibles and miscellaneous trophies.
The platinum unlocks with the 54th trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, Jason's first job. Just play the mission through to its end — there is no special requirement, no collectible and no choice that gates it. It is the first story trophy of Chapter 1, so it should be among the first trophies you ever earn in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Finish it — the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the last mission of Chapter 1 ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole game that can be missed — meditate at the first meditation spot, offered at home (see Positive Mental Attitude). PowerPyx warns there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 home spot before the chapter ends.
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 2 ends. By Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, which is when most of the open-world list opens up — activities, races, robberies and partner trophies all become available, so use the chapter to start scanning vehicles and trying activities as you travel between missions. No extra objective is needed for the trophy itself.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions with Jason and Lucia.
Try activities and scan vehicles along the way — they count toward later trophies.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 3 ends. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter — the game has no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back if you later realise you skipped something. Side content you do during the chapter (stranger strands, activities, collectibles) already counts toward the 100% checklist even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (progress counts before the checklist is visible)

steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 3.
Play through the chapter's missions.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when Chapter 4 ends, leaving only the finale. Before the final mission, make a dedicated manual save — several guides recommend one save at the start of every chapter and one right before the finale, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Anything you have not finished can still be done in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 4.
Play through the chapter's missions.
Make a second manual save before the final mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only gold among the story trophies: it pops when the final mission ends and the credits roll. After the story you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — everything still needed for the platinum remains accessible there. Do not use cheats on your trophy save: PowerPyx reports that cheats disable trophies and saving.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

steps: Finish the final mission from your pre-finale manual save.
The gold trophy pops at the end.
Continue in free-roam; the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one unlock automatically as you play the chapters — there is no side objective to complete and no way to skip the mission, so simply keep following the story. If a mission is giving you trouble, retrying it is free: there are no mission medals to worry about.
trophies.name: Trust

Treat it as a progress marker rather than a challenge — the real work of the platinum is the open-world checklist that comes after the story.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish the mission Child's Play. Keep playing the chapters in order and it will come to you.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish the mission Headliners. This is one of the six named-mission story trophies; all six are automatic story progress and none can be missed. If you are tracking your run, it marks roughly the middle of the story's mission chain.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The mission's name is also a hint for the miscellaneous trophy Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA — that one is a separate free-roam stunt, not part of this mission, so do not confuse the two.

With the chapter trophies, that makes 12 story trophies in total (11 bronze and 1 gold), all hidden until earned and none missable, according to SixShore's count of the list.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the biggest single time sink: reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and progress you made during the story already counts. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and 300 stunts; Strangers & Freaks strands are NOT needed for 100%. Budget about 100 hours for this step alone.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% checklist thresholds)

steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Work the checklist: 70/80 challenges, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 50/66 weapons, 300 stunts.
Skip the hardest challenges — 10 can be skipped.
The gold pops at 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world in total. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy: every stunt you land during the story and free-roam counts. Stunt jumps are the easiest to farm, since the game marks them; bridge flights and base jumps need more setup, so leave those until you are hunting the last few.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (250 of 397 stunts; 300 for 100%)

steps: Land stunt jumps as you explore — they are marked in the world.
Mix in bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Reach 250 for the silver; push to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish anything. The types are the game's side activities (races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and similar open-world pastimes). Work through them early, while you are still travelling between story missions, and the trophy pops when the ninth type registers.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (9 activity types)

steps: Open the activities list as you explore Leonida.
Try one of each of the 9 activity types.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count comes from PSNProfiles' tracker, which lists 42 challenges. This is a pure skill trophy: visit the shooting ranges around Leonida, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay any challenge until the gold threshold is met. It is one of the six silvers, so expect it to take several sessions; do a few challenges between story missions instead of grinding all 42 in one sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (42 Shooting Range challenges)

steps: Find a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Play each of the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge until you earn its gold medal.
The silver pops when all 42 are gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are one of the activity types, so a win here also feeds Master of None. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then race it properly — winning needs a clean run more than top speed, since one crash usually costs the race. Tick locations off one by one; the trophy pops on the fourteenth win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (14 locations)

steps: Find the Top Fun drone race spots around Leonida (14 in total).
Learn each course, then win the race there.
Repeat at every location — the trophy pops on the 14th win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida in several vehicle classes, so vary your rides and work through the race list methodically. Pick a race, learn its corners, and restart if you bin it early; a win in each new event ticks the count up by one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find race events around Leonida.
Win a race in 20 different events.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities, and Cal is the rival angler who challenges you to it — find the fishing spots, take the challenge, and out-fish him. If you lose, just challenge him again: fishing challenges can be retried, and the trophy only needs a single win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a fishing spot and take the fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.
Retry if you lose — one win pops the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, start to end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find and play it through; you do not need a high score, just a completion. Arcade machines are also one of the 9 activity types, so this feeds Master of None too.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida.
Start an arcade game and play it to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Andy is one of the side characters who gives you a chain of missions outside the main story — work through his jobs in order until the strand's last mission, then finish it. Character strands like Andy's are separate from the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, but they play the same way: follow the contact's missions until the chain ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Andy and take his missions as they appear.
Work through the whole strand in order.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. Kenton is another side contact with a mission chain of his own — take his jobs when they appear on the map and follow the strand to its last mission. Side strands can be done at any point once unlocked, and they stay available in free-roam after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Kenton and take his missions as they appear.
Work through the whole strand in order.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. Billy's chain works like Andy's and Kenton's: a series of side missions from one contact, ending in a final job. Do his missions whenever they show up — the strand stays open in free-roam after the story, so you can finish it during the cleanup step of the roadmap.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Billy and take his missions as they appear.
Work through the whole strand in order.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map — each one is a short mission chain of its own. PowerPyx notes these strands are NOT part of the 100% checklist, so they are pure trophy work for this silver; save most of them for the cleanup step after the story, when you can sweep the map strand by strand. Eight completed strands pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Strangers & Freaks not needed for 100%)

steps: Look for stranger markers (?) around Leonida.
Complete a stranger's whole mission strand.
Repeat until 8 strands are done — the silver pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. Randy is one of the five named side contacts with a final-mission trophy (alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy and Tyrone). Follow his jobs in order until the chain ends; like the other contact strands, it stays available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Randy and take his missions as they appear.
Work through the whole strand in order.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand — the last of the five named contact strands. Tyrone's jobs are taken in order like the others, and the strand's final mission is the trophy. Once all five contact trophies are done, the only side strands left are the 8 Strangers & Freaks chains for their silver.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Tyrone and take his missions as they appear.
Work through the whole strand in order.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — this is the ONLY trophy any guide flags as possibly missable, so read this carefully. PowerPyx reports 18 spots in 10 locations, usable by Jason and Lucia, and the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1: it becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate at the home spot before Chapter 1 ends. The other 17 spots stay available, and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 — but this trophy needs all 18, so the Chapter 1 spot is the one that matters.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (only possibly missable trophy; first meditation in Chapter 1)
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List (18 spots, 10 locations)

steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the home spot BEFORE the chapter ends — this is the missable one.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as backup.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida.
The trophy pops at the 18th spot.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret sends you after one specific animal — find the hunting area he points you to, track the animal, and take it down. Hunting is also one of the activity types, and studying animals through binoculars counts toward the 100% checklist (100 of 255), so scan animals with the binoculars whenever you are out hunting anyway.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100 of 255 animals for 100%)

steps: Find Bret and take the hunt.
Track the unique animal in the area he marks.
Take it down — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect them and complete any 3 full sets for this silver. Cards are one of the game's collectible families, so sweep them area by area; a map or checklist helps, since a single missing card holds a whole set back. You do not need every card in the game, just 3 finished sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore Leonida.
Track which sets are close to complete.
Finish any 3 full sets — the silver pops.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — WAiNK is the in-game app for scanning and discovering things around Leonida, and the same app feeds the vehicle-scanning progress the 100% checklist wants (200 of 277 vehicles). Open WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan what it offers; the count climbs naturally if you make a habit of it on every trip, and the silver pops at 100 locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (WAiNK vehicle scanning for 100%)

steps: Open the WAiNK app at new locations as you travel.
Scan what it offers — vehicles, spots, points of interest.
Reach 100 locations for the silver.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's open-world task list — 80 in total, spanning driving, combat, exploration and activities. You only need 50 for this trophy, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so keep doing them past this one; PowerPyx notes the 10 hardest challenges can be skipped entirely for 100%. Pick off the easy ones first (driving and exploration challenges), then work down the list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (70 of 80 challenges for 100%)

steps: Open the challenges list and note the easy ones.
Complete any 50 challenges for the bronze.
Push to 70 for the 100% checklist — the 10 hardest can be skipped.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner matters: the trophy only counts when you are together, so do it during a stretch where Lucia or Jason is with you. Raise heat by committing crimes in front of police, then break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears completely.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play with your partner alongside you.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Lose the cops and escape until the stars clear — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: here you must STAY wanted through all three robberies. Plan a route past three shops close together, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them so the cops stay on you but never catch you. If the wanted level clears between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play with your partner alongside you and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob the first shop to gain a wanted level.
Rob the other two quickly, staying wanted throughout.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles around Leonida — scan them with the WAiNK app as you find them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy is a milestone on the way: make scanning a habit every time you see a new vehicle, and the count climbs on its own. Vehicles in traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles all count once discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (200 of 277 vehicles for 100%)

steps: Open the WAiNK app when you spot a new vehicle.
Scan it to discover it.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles; keep going to 200 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the game's slow-down aiming mode). Set it up: find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before the effect ends. If you only get 4, the count resets — so pick a busy fight, aim for the closest targets first, and use a weapon with a fast fire rate.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a fight with 5+ enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down 5 enemies before it ends — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: get a plane at the airport and take off without following the normal route, or steal a plane and leave the airport by air on your own terms. Any aircraft at VCIA works; the trophy is about leaving the airport in a plane rather than through the terminal, so grab one from the tarmac or a hangar and get airborne.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA).
Get into a plane on the tarmac or in a hangar.
Take off — an unscheduled departure pops the trophy.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and deal with the heat it brings. In practice this is the tank trophy — find a Rhino (military base or high wanted level), take it for a spin, and survive the police response it draws. The trophy's exact trigger is one of the less-documented ones at launch, so treat the Rhino itself as the goal: drive it, use it, and stay alive in it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a Rhino tank (military areas or a high wanted level).
Get in and drive it.
Survive the response — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery. Case the store first, go in quiet, take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are seen, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again. Plan your entry and exit routes before you start, and keep your partner out of sight until you are inside.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry and exit.
Rob it without being spotted or tripping an alarm.
Leave undetected — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — five successful vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Vault robberies are bigger setups than shop robberies: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the take, and escape the police response before the trophy counts that vault. Five escapes earn this silver; do them one at a time and restock between jobs.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a bank with a robbable vault.
Rob the vault, then escape the police.
Repeat for 5 vaults — the silver pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — spot one, stop it (ram it, block the road, or force the driver out), crack it open, take the cash, and then lose the police response. One successful robbery plus a clean escape pops the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack it open.
Take the cash, then escape the police — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the keys. The game tracks area discovery, so the work is simply going everywhere: drive the highways, visit each town and district, and check the map for the areas you have not set foot in yet. It pairs naturally with scanning vehicles and WAiNK locations, so do it on the same road trips.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (52 areas)

steps: Drive through every district and town in Leonida.
Watch the map for undiscovered areas.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are visited.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one operation per gang, nine in total. Illegal operations are gang-run spots around Leonida; hitting one angers that gang, so expect a fight on the way out. Work through the gangs one by one and keep a note of which you have already robbed, since the trophy only counts when all nine are done.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (9 gangs)

steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob it and get out.
Repeat for all 9 gangs — the trophy pops on the ninth.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is one of the game's quiet, specific moments: go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach in Vice City, order a cocktail, and take in the view. No guide had pinned down the exact trigger at launch — PowerPyx and GTABase list this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet — so the practical advice is: visit the Ocean Beach bars, order a drink at the waterfront, and try the spots with a sea view until it pops.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions — the count comes from GTA Scoop's list, which gives this trophy a 500-action target. Criminal Profile actions are the small criminal choices and acts the game tracks in your profile: robberies, thefts, and other illicit acts as you play. There is no single trick — just play criminally and consistently, and the count climbs. It is a grind trophy, not a skill one, so it will likely pop on its own during a long platinum run.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty cash you pick up from robberies and jobs — take them to your contacts to wash them into clean money, and the laundered total climbs toward $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering through the whole run; bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies all feed the pile, so this trophy finishes naturally if you keep the money moving.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops of Leonida sell. The counter is cumulative across every shop, so just play the game: buy the guns and gear you actually need, and the total climbs. If you are close near the end of the run, top it off with a big purchase — a car or a weapon — to cross the line.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are buyable properties that store your vehicles — find them on the map, save up, and buy each one. Eight purchases is the whole set, and each garage also helps you keep the cars you need for the vehicle trophies, so buy them as you can afford them rather than leaving all eight for the end.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

Any 10 vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive; this pairs well with the vehicle discovery and garage trophies, since the same cars feed all three.
